title: ♻️ Simplify reading files in memory, do it sequentially instead of (fake) parallel
decision: Simplify reading files in memory, do it sequentially instead of (fake) parallel
why: Files from a single request are read sequentially so in-memory reading won't make a difference, OS reads SpooledTemporaryFiles sequentially, and it avoids spawning many tasks at once
quote: so this parallelization doesn't really achieve anything.
